title: C3 glomerulonephritis
diseaseDescription: Bounded C3GN map: alternative complement pathway dysregulation, acquired convertase stabilization, complement-regulatory variants and glomerular complement deposition. Dense deposit disease is excluded as a phenotype; mixed C3 glomerulopathy studies are labelled and cannot establish C3GN-specific effects. Infection-related and immune-complex glomerulonephritis are excluded.
releaseNote: Bounded agent-source-checked candidate from five primary abstracts. Heterogeneous assays, genetic associations, C3GN pathology and mixed-C3G intervention evidence remain distinct. Therapy catalog and independent review pending; no comprehensive coverage claimed.

entities.label: C3 nephritic factors
entities.description: Autoantibodies with heterogeneous activity on the alternative-pathway C3 convertase.

entities.label: Alternative-pathway C3 convertase
entities.description: C3bBb enzyme complex; stabilization and susceptibility to regulation vary with nephritic factor and properdin.

entities.label: Alternative complement pathway dysregulation
entities.description: Selected acquired and genetic abnormalities identified in patients; not a universal single cause.

entities.label: Complement-regulatory gene variants
entities.description: Reported CFH, CFI, CD46 and CFHR variants in selected cohorts; pathogenicity is not assumed for every variant.

entities.label: Anti-factor H autoantibodies
entities.description: Heterogeneous antibodies studied in alternative-pathway glomerulopathies; their functional effects are sample-specific.

entities.label: Factor H regulatory activity
entities.description: Factor H cofactor activity and cell-surface protection are distinct assay endpoints.

entities.label: Glomerular complement deposits
entities.description: AP and terminal complement proteins detected by proteomics in C3GN glomeruli.

entities.label: C3GN renal phenotype
entities.description: Biopsy-defined C3GN with variable proliferative patterns, hematuria, proteinuria and clinical course; DDD is excluded.

entities.label: Iptacopan exposure
entities.description: Oral factor B inhibitor studied as an adjunct to background care in mixed C3 glomerulopathy; no subtype-specific estimate is inferred.

entities.label: Proteinuria
entities.description: Urinary protein excretion; trial UPCR is a surrogate endpoint, distinct from long-term kidney survival.

claims.text: Patient nephritic-factor IgG stabilized alternative-pathway C3 convertase in biochemical assays.
limitations: Mixed renal-disease population; assay activity does not establish C3GN causation or universal patient prevalence.
Abstract-only source inspection; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Nephritic-factor effects were heterogeneous: representative properdin-independent samples did not increase C5 cleavage or terminal activity.
limitations: Qualifies any extrapolation from convertase stabilization to universal terminal-pathway activation.
Abstract-only source inspection; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: C3 nephritic factors were the most common acquired alternative-pathway abnormality in the 12-case C3GN series.
limitations: Small selected case series; no population prevalence or causal sufficiency established.
Abstract-only source inspection; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: CFH, CFI and CFHR mutations were among the abnormalities reported in the C3GN series.
limitations: Individual variant function and penetrance cannot be resolved from the abstract.
Abstract-only source inspection; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Complement-regulatory gene mutations were detected in both proliferative and nonproliferative isolated-C3 glomerulonephritis groups, with differing frequencies.
limitations: Historical diagnostic categories predate modern C3G criteria; selected cohort and subgroup sizes limit generalization.
Abstract-only source inspection; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Glomerular proteomics identified alternative-pathway and terminal-complement proteins in the C3GN case series.
limitations: Deposited proteins do not by themselves prove the sequence or sufficiency of injury mechanisms.
Abstract-only source inspection; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Patients in the C3GN series typically had hematuria and proteinuria alongside glomerular complement deposits.
limitations: Clinicopathological association; does not prove deposits alone cause clinical manifestations.
Abstract-only source inspection; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Most patients with native kidney disease had stable renal function during reported follow-up, qualifying an inevitable progressive-failure interpretation.
limitations: Small selected series; this is not an estimate of long-term kidney survival for all C3GN.
Abstract-only source inspection; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Anti-factor H IgG from three glomerulopathy patients affected factor H factor-I cofactor activity in functional assays.
limitations: Broad glomerulopathy cohort; functional effect in three samples cannot be generalized to all C3GN or all anti-FH antibodies.
Abstract-only source inspection; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: In the reported assays, glomerulopathy anti-FH antibodies did not perturb factor H cell-surface protection or ligand binding.
limitations: Different regulatory functions are distinct endpoints; antibody detection alone does not establish universal functional inhibition.
Abstract-only source inspection; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: In APPEAR-C3G, iptacopan reduced 24-hour UPCR relative to placebo by 35.1% at six months on background care in adults with C3 glomerulopathy.
limitations: Mixed C3G enrollment; no C3GN-specific efficacy estimate or long-term kidney-survival benefit established by this abstract. Trial funded by Novartis.
Abstract-only source inspection; independent domain review pending.
